information.en: Spinal Cord Toolbox (SCT): automatic spinal cord segmentation with sct_deepseg spinalcord (contrast-agnostic)

regulatory_information.safety_advices: For research use only. Not for diagnostic use.
regulatory_information.special_operating_instructions: Input must be a magnitude image series covering the spinal cord. Segmentation runs on CPU and may take a few minutes.
regulatory_information.additional_relevant_information: Based on Spinal Cord Toolbox https://spinalcordtoolbox.com

information.en: SCT processing to run on the incoming images
Also send back the original images (no suffix), in addition to the processed series
Also send back the original images with the segmentation contour burned in (suffix _SCTOverlay)
